description: F2 and the pencil of the agent cards rename the tab of an agent. A button asks a small AI model for a short name from the agent's session.

settings.label: AI program
settings.hint: The program that makes the name. Auto: Claude Code when it is installed, else Codex.

settings.label: Model
settings.hint: Empty: haiku for Claude Code, gpt-6-luna for Codex.

settings.label: Name language
settings.hint: The language of the names that the AI makes.

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. It replaces Herdr's F2 (tab.rename).
